questions.text: Describe your approach to implementing Adobe Target across our regional brands and markets.
sections: Our approach
We would deliver this with Target.
What we would do
We will enable Target in the datastream, add flicker handling, render Visual and Form-based Experience Composer activities, pass profile and entity data, and validate the setup.
We will add users and roles, create workspaces and properties where you have Target Premium, and set up the reporting, environment and starting audience settings.
We will run an ideation and prioritization workshop, write activity plans with hypotheses and success metrics, then build, QA and launch the first A/B and Experience Targeting activities.
After launch
Each month we will design, build, QA and launch the next activities on the roadmap, analyze results by audience, and share readouts and next steps with stakeholders.

questions.text: Include how you would train our authors.
Describe your approach to implementing Marketo Engage.
sections: Our approach
We would deliver this with Marketo Engage.
What we would do

We will agree the field mapping with the CRM admin before the first sync, connect Marketo Engage to Salesforce or Dynamics, choose which fields sync or stay hidden, and check that the sync is running correctly.

We will complete the initial setup steps and protocols, set up SPF and DKIM, the CNAMEs for branded tracking links and landing pages, install the Munchkin code on the website, and set up users and roles.
We will design the program templates the team will clone (webinar, nurture, newsletter, event), with My Tokens, and build the branded email templates, landing pages and forms in Design Studio.
After launch
Each month we will review Admin, Marketing Activities, Design Studio and Database for clean-up, deliverability and scoring changes, and agree the fixes with your Marketo owner.
